prompt:
Write src/data/shadow-journey.ts for the Atlas of Education site: the narrated landing page for the SHADOW EDUCATION family (private tutoring in Cambodia, especially pupils paying their own teachers).

FORMAT: follow src/data/angkor-journey.ts exactly (read it: it is the template and the house style). Start with:
import type { Journey } from './angkor-journey'
export const shadowJourney: Journey = { kicker, title, lede, repo: 'https://github.com/TreyModels/atlas-of-education', family: 'shadow', why: [...], chapters: [...], deeper: [...], models: {...}, bottomLine }
Types: Purpose 'published'|'mechanism'|'teaching'|'accounting'; DevState 'checked'|'developing'|'historical'|'evaluated'; Claim 'published'|'data'|'sim'|'open'|'method'. Each chapter has id, kicker, title, question, evidence[], rule[], result[], limitation[], optional maths {plain, formula, symbols, example}, sources[] ({label, href}), models[] (card ids). NO `interactive` field (no sliders on this page).

STORY (5-6 chapters, plain English, short paragraphs, honest):
1. The puzzle and the published patterns: why pupils pay their own teachers; what the literature and surveys report (use only facts and sources present in the context files; Bray is the key literature; 'published' or 'data' claims).
2. Three rival explanations: diversion (teachers hold back regular teaching to sell tutoring), favour (buying from your own teacher earns better treatment or marks), thin curriculum (timetabled hours are too few for the curriculum). One plain sentence each, then how each becomes a rule in the shared agent-based model.
3. Calibration against the published patterns: what the fitting did and what it found, using the numbers in the context, CLEARLY labelled historical, because the provider observation equation and the SMC evidence estimator were later corrected and new calibration runs are required.
4. Can the explanations be told apart? The favour/thin equivalence: favour is the same model as thin after a relabelling, wherever the commercial-cost floor does not bind. Include a maths block with the worked example below. Diversion mostly behaves like thin. The three share one model.py (6 of ~215 lines differ), so their agreement on policy is shared code, not independent evidence.
5. What would separate them: the proposed signatures (favour: own-teacher purchases affect internal marks differently from external exams; diversion: within-teacher regular coverage differs where tutoring can be sold; thin: take-up responds to curriculum load relative to timetabled hours). These are proposals, not established ('open').
Optional 6: the credential-floor DHS test if the context supports it; otherwise a deeper card only.

WORKED EXAMPLE for the maths block (from Codex's review; illustrative numbers, not estimates): utilities with diversion off: U_own = b + f, U_other = b - c_o, U_commercial = b - c_c, no-purchase = 0; logit probability exp(U_j)/[1 + sum exp(U_k)]. Set f = 0 and use b' = b + f, c_o' = c_o + f, c_c' = c_c + f: all utilities identical, so probabilities identical. Example b = 1, f = 0.5, c_o = 0.3, c_c = 0.8: own 1.5 / 1.5; other 0.7 / 1.5 - 0.8 = 0.7; commercial 0.2 / 1.5 - 1.3 = 0.2. Qualifications (put in limitation): the implementation clamps commercial cost at zero after the commercial-entry policy, so the transformation can fail when the floor binds; of 116 distinct fitted favour sets, 32 transformed outside the thin variant's prior ranges; diversion can generate withholding, so the algebra does not prove all three identical everywhere; a classifier struggling in a finite experiment does not prove no data could separate them. Recommended wording: "The current aggregate targets poorly distinguish the variants; favour and thin are equivalent under the stated transformation where the commercial-cost floor does not bind."

MODEL CARDS (ids): 'shadow-lab' (the interactive lab page; purpose mechanism; state historical or developing, say why; research: 'research/shadow-education.html'; route 'shadow-education' only if that id appears as a route in the context, otherwise omit route), 'tutoring-abm' (code bundle; engine: 'research/shadow/tutoring_abm.zip'; state historical: calibration bundle predates corrections), 'credential-dhs' (engine: 'research/shadow/credential_floor_dhs.zip'), and 'research-folder' (research track; purpose mechanism; state developing; no engine; research link as an absolute GitHub URL https://github.com/TreyModels/atlas-of-education/tree/main/research/shadow-education). Use only these relative links; external links must be absolute https.

RULES: every number must come from the context files or this prompt; never invent numbers, sources or quotes. No categorical words like "ruled out" or "proves". Teaching-friendly, descriptive (KIDS), candid about development state. bottomLine: 2-3 sentences. Return only the one file.
